description: The GCC-KNC project's card: Xeon Phi x100 with 61 cores at 1.238 GHz and 16 GB GDDR5 (7120-class). Latencies, throughputs and bandwidths below were measured natively on this card by the project's characterization runs (S6-03 on 2026-11-06, S8-01/S8-10/S8-12/S8-17 on 2026-11-07..09), recorded in docs/research/knc-characterization.md of the gcc_knc repository. Units are TSC ticks per operation at one thread unless stated; the TSC (about 1232 MHz) and the core clock (1238 MHz, governor performance) agree within 0.5%, so ticks are treated as core cycles.
native_measurement_ids: S6-03: card_run jobs claude-0380b2ec, claude-7191652b, claude-b1f534af (2026-11-06), .work/_shared/S6-03/knc-char.mic, median of five group medians, spread <2% unless starred

calibration.statement: Single-core instruction latencies, throughputs, cache/memory latencies and a few whole-card bandwidth and barrier figures are imported from native microbenchmarks on this card. No end-to-end kernel prediction of this engine has yet been compared against a native measurement; the held-out validation set is empty. Predictions are therefore model outputs built from measured parameters, not validated predictions.

card.model.value: Xeon Phi x100, 61 cores, 1.238 GHz, 16 GB (7120-class; exact SKU not recorded)
card.model.source: project config; core count and clock read on the card (S6-01 R1 logs)

card.clock_hz.source: S6-01 run logs (governor performance, 1,238,094 kHz; S8-17 C12 confirmed no throttling)

card.tsc_hz.source: S6-01 R1 lines 245-265 (about 1232.199 MHz); invariance not proven

card.usable_cores.source: S6-01 placement protocol: cores 0-59 for jobs, OS core CPUs {0,241,242,243} excluded

card.memory_bytes.source: Intel 7120 specification; project card-full.json allows 13312 MB per job

card.peak_memory_bandwidth_gbs.source: Intel 7120 specification; R08 ('Peak Memory Bandwidth of Xeon Phi SE10P is 352 GB/s')

card.sustained_bandwidth_gbs.unit: GB/s by traffic type, 60 cores x 4 threads
card.sustained_bandwidth_gbs.source: read_modify_write: S8-17 C12 stream phase 156.5 GB/s; write_normal/write_ngo: S8-01 C1 at 60x4 (83.5 and 226.1 GB/s median worker; NGO completed-worker estimate 204.5)
card.sustained_bandwidth_gbs.uncertainty: read_only is not measured (the project's target is 264-299 GB/s); NGO figures differ between estimates (204.5 vs 226.1) and a later sweep gave 169.7 under different work.

card.barrier_ns.source: S8-10 C11: fan-in-4 tree 5,521-6,469 ns; one shared counter 26,810-28,410 ns (three launches)

latency.remote_l2_line_ns.unit: ns per load of a line in another core's L2
latency.remote_l2_line_ns.source: S8-10 C11: 190.6-195.0 ns, near and far owner alike
latency.remote_l2_line_ns.uncertainty: R08 reports ~275 ns on SE10P; R22 shows physical address matters.

latency.mask_op.source: S6-03 kand.lat 2.08 bounds it at <=2; 1 assumed like scalar

latency.vector_arith.source: S6-03 vaddps.lat 4.02, vmulps.lat 4.03, vfmadd213ps.lat 4.02, vpaddd.lat 4.03, vpxord.lat 4.03, vaddpd/vmulpd/vfmadd213pd 4.03, vcvtfxpntdq2ps/ps2dq 4.03
latency.vector_arith.applies_to: all vector arithmetic, logic, SP/DP FMA and dq<->ps conversions

latency.vector_long.applies_to: permutes, swizzles, vrcp23ps; vrsqrt23ps/vlog2ps/vexp223ps assumed in the same class (not measured)

latency.vector_load_l1.source: S6-03 masked_load.lat 12.11, convert_up.lat 12.11, spill_reload.lat 12.11 (dependent chains through memory-operand forms, one thread)
latency.vector_load_l1.uncertainty: R08 documents 3 cycles for vector loads; the measured chains include a store or a vector-to-address path and may overstate a pure load-to-use. Use the alternative scenario for a sensitivity check.

latency.l2_hit.source: S6-03 l2.load_lat 24.42 (one thread), 25.68 at four threads
latency.l2_hit.uncertainty: R17 slide 14 documents 11 raw cycles; literature (R06, R08) measures 22-25.

latency.memory.source: S6-03 memory.load_lat 356.53 (one thread, idle); 365.76 at four threads
latency.memory.uncertainty: Loaded latency is higher (R08); not measured under load here.

latency.agi_cycles.source: S6-03 agi.gap0 3.11 vs 2.08 baseline at one thread: the dependent load issued one cycle after its earliest slot, i.e. address usable 3 cycles after the write issued; R01 p.19

latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.unit: cycles per branch in the pseudorandom test
latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.source: S8-01 C10: 11.27 vs 6.22 ticks per branch at one thread (difference 5.05)
latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.uncertainty: The test did not separate the miss rate; if half the branches missed, the penalty per miss is about 10. The model charges this value per branch the scenario marks mispredicted.

latency.branch_taken_bubble.source: S8-01 C9: loop costs about 2 ticks per vector op plus 2 per loop branch at one thread (the branch costs its issue slot only)

latency.scalar_imul.source: R02 p.56; not measured on this card by the imported runs

latency.x87_div.source: S6-03 x87_div.lat 39.25, .rt 38.24; one divide per 38 cycles per core at four threads

occupancy.x87_mul.source: S6-03 x87_mul.rt 4.02 per thread at two threads (one per 2 cycles per core)

occupancy.x87_div.source: S6-03 x87_div.rt 151.76 per thread at four threads (37.9 per core)

latency.gather_first_line.source: S6-03 gather_all.lat 15.10 (16 lanes in one line, one thread)

occupancy.gather_cycles_per_line.source: S6-03 gather_all.rt 7.08 per gather at one thread, 7.02 per core at four; gather_scattered (16 lines) 127 per core
occupancy.gather_cycles_per_line.uncertainty: 16 lines measured 127 per core, more than 16 x 7 = 112; the per-line figure is optimistic for scattered gathers.

occupancy.vprefetch_l2_core_cycles.source: S8-01 C2: vprefetch1 4.52 per thread at two threads, 9.01 at four (about 2.25 per core); modeled as 2 (integer cycles)
occupancy.vprefetch_l2_core_cycles.uncertainty: 2.25 measured; the integer model understates by about 11%.

memory.lines_per_cycle_per_core_measured.unit: lines per core cycle, sequential loads at four threads with the hardware prefetcher active
memory.lines_per_cycle_per_core_measured.source: S6-03 memory.load_rt 77.92 per thread at four threads (19.5 ticks per line per core, about 4 GB/s per core at one core)
memory.lines_per_cycle_per_core_measured.note: Informational: includes the L2 hardware prefetcher, which the simulator does not model.

latency.spill_reload_chain.unit: cycles for a store followed by a dependent reload

latency.store_to_load_same_line.unit: cycles after a store issues before a load of the same line can use the data in L1
latency.store_to_load_same_line.source: chosen so that store->vector reload matches the measured 12-cycle spill/reload chain with latency.vector_load_l1 = 12 only if the load waits no extra; S8-12 C9 memory chain 11 per link

latency.fence.source: lock addl is used as a publication fence by the project but its latency was not measured
